evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Obliteration of posterior horn of lateral meniscus with increased signal intensity, C/W tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular carilage and spur formation and tiny subchondral cysts, reflectiong osteoarthritis, more severe at lateral compartment.
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing of articular carilage and spur formation and tiny subchondral cysts, reflectiong osteoarthritis, more severe at lateral compartment.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion and suprapatellar and medial plicae
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
